# sh-fpv-app-header

**Purpose:** App header states. Default = transparent header over the photo area. Onscroll / Alternate = on-scroll treatments; these are app header states, not a separate status-bar widget. The OS status bar is device chrome (a mock, never built as app UI).

Full profile view (migration, not yet core) · 2 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2877-15883) (node `2877:15883`)

*Generated by `tools/components.py` from Figma. Values are token names; never copy numbers.*

## Types

### State=Onscroll

**When:** after scrolling past the photo — sticky header (Onscroll). To be folded into sh-app-header.

### State=Alternate

**When:** after scrolling past the photo — sticky header (Alternate). To be folded into sh-app-header.

## Properties

| Property | Type | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| State | variant | Onscroll, Alternate | Onscroll |
